content: I am the Chief Technology Officer. I claim this ad hoc intent (no prior queue item): the user directed a real, live pilot demonstrating that a Chief-level cognitive trail is a persona at the top of the existing PMCR-O mechanism, not a parallel engine, and directed that its concrete work run as ordinary micro-workflow frames recorded in this project's own trail evidence, not simulated elsewhere. Concretely: register the real host-device-bridge capability this session already demonstrated live this session (a device-link query, a real folder-access grant, real file reads via the proxied Desktop Commander MCP server, and a real mid-session disconnect and recovery) into this repository's capability/provider/mcp registries and one narrowly-scoped evidence skill, and register a new pmcro-chief-technology-officer plugin (persona plus that skill) in the canonical plugin marketplace manifest. I hand this off to Planner now.
